name: Copenhagen Park Bench
summary: 1800 mm outdoor Copenhagen park bench with European oak slats, cast-iron frames, and stainless fasteners.
description: Detailed 1.80 x 0.66 x 0.85 m outdoor park bench modeled in Lite-STEP. Includes seven contoured oak seat slats, five backrest slats, solid oak armrest caps, three cast-iron leg frames with tie rods, and stainless carriage/anchor bolts.
